# Papers

*Generated by `scripts/hq-status.py` from [`docs/sources.json`](sources.json); back to the [README](../README.md).*

The formalization pins 49 sources. The PDFs live in `sources/pdf/` (kept out of git) with their SHA-256 hashes in [`sources/SHA256SUMS`](../sources/SHA256SUMS); arXiv versions were read from the pinned PDFs, and DOIs come from the arXiv API or exact Crossref title matches. Each entry says what the project uses the source for, which frozen theorems cite it, and how many errata were recorded against it (see the README's errata section).

## Core sources of the KAM proof (track K)

### HL19

A. Haro, A. Luque, *A-posteriori KAM theory with optimal estimates for partially integrable systems*, J. Differential Equations (2019)

Links: [arXiv:1711.05515v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.05515v1) · [doi:10.1016/j.jde.2018.08.003](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jde.2018.08.003)

**Used for.** Primary for the fixed-frequency a-posteriori theorem: Thm 3.1 (§3.2) with d = n, explicit constants in App. B

**Cited by the frozen theorems** `KAM.aposteriori_kam`, `KAM.Iso.isoenergetic_kam`, `KAM.Iso.all_time_confinement`, `KAM.Iso.kepler_bordered_det`, `KAM.Iso.restricted_near_circular`.

**Errata recorded:** 25 entries.

### GJLV05

R. de la Llave, A. González, À. Jorba, J. Villanueva, *KAM theory without action-angle variables*, Nonlinearity 18 (2005) 855–895

Links: [doi:10.1088/0951-7715/18/2/020](https://doi.org/10.1088/0951-7715/18/2/020)

**Used for.** A-posteriori theorem for flows (Thm 5, p. 865) and maps (Thm 1); local uniqueness for maps (Thm 2, p. 862; proof §6, pp. 883–885), the template for our flow version; automatic Lagrangian property (Lemma 19 / Prop. 18)

**Cited by the frozen theorems** `KAM.local_uniqueness_flow`.

**Errata recorded:** 6 entries.

### CCdlL13

R. Calleja, A. Celletti, R. de la Llave, *A KAM theory for conformally symplectic systems: efficient algorithms and their validation*, J. Differential Equations 255 (2013) 978–1049

Links: [doi:10.1016/j.jde.2013.05.001](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jde.2013.05.001)

**Used for.** Lipschitz dependence on the frequency by re-applying the a-posteriori theorem (Cor. 29–30, normalization (5.3)); pinned preprint mp_arc 11-188

**Errata recorded:** 2 entries.

### Pos01

J. Pöschel, *A lecture on the classical KAM theorem*, Proc. Symp. Pure Math. 69 (2001) 707–732

Links: [arXiv:0908.2234v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/0908.2234v1)

**Used for.** Measure assembly: Prop. 1–2 (p. 11) with the Lipschitz (McShane) extension of App. B (p. 31); measure of Diophantine vectors (§1d, p. 5); pinned arXiv text is Version 1.3 (2009)

**Cited by the frozen theorems** `KAM.kam_positive_measure`, `KAM.kam_positive_measure_qualitative`, `KAM.volume_not_diophantine_le`.

**Errata recorded:** 7 entries.

### FHL17

J.-Ll. Figueras, A. Haro, A. Luque, *Rigorous computer assisted application of KAM theory: a modern approach*, Found. Comput. Math. 17 (2017)

Links: [arXiv:1601.00084v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/1601.00084v1) · [doi:10.1007/s10208-016-9339-3](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10208-016-9339-3)

**Used for.** Explicit a-posteriori constants (Thm 2.5, maps); measure of Diophantine vectors (§4.1); Rüssmann estimates (§4.2)
